steps: Name it; restrict its permissions to what you need and set 'Expire After'
Click 'Create' and copy the key — it is shown exactly once

limited.meaning: the key is valid but is not allowed to read your account (the check needs the user-read permission); that is fine for a locked-down key

body_rules.meaning: the key is valid but lacks the permission the check needs (user read); it will work for what you gave it

unverified: validate (how a restricted key answers is not in the vendor docs)

least_privilege.summary: Restrict the key to only the features you use (e.g. text-to-speech) and set an expiry.
